findings.summary: First arming dismisses 38 standing approvals against 2 people; missing submitted_at cutoff, once-only guard, and EXEMPT_LABELS check.
findings.fate_evidence: Commit 2e374f4ce added submitted_at cutoff and EXEMPT_LABELS check; commits d3e998fea and 19028737b added once-only guard via review_dismissed timeline event.

findings.summary: Double fetch of /pulls/{n}/reviews in rule_approval_shape and last_changes_requested_without_push.
findings.fate_evidence: Commit a7a9f21da shared single reviews fetch across both rules using a memo keyed on PR number.

findings.summary: /pulls/{n}/comments reads line comments only; substantive review body is dismissed as bare.
findings.fate_evidence: Commit 7d18f5ad3 accepted non-blank review["body"] as evidence of engagement.

findings.summary: mergeable != "CONFLICTING" admits UNKNOWN, flapping needs-committer-review label on busy base branch.
findings.fate_evidence: Commit e72e871c8 required confirmed pr.mergeable == "MERGEABLE" state.

findings.summary: gh() with check=True in apply_intents has no try/except; one failing dismissal wedges all subsequent PR intents in sweep.
findings.fate_evidence: Commit a99ba1519 added per-item try/except around review dismissal calls in apply_intents.

findings.summary: Dismissal message cites charter section 3 which does not define 40-line rule or automated dismissal.
findings.fate_evidence: Author split the governance rule amendment into charter PR #5746, but scripts/queue_hygiene.py was not updated and PR #5746 is unmerged.

findings.summary: _is_bot checks login suffix/prefix instead of user.type == 'Bot'; startswith('app/') is dead GraphQL syntax in REST payload.
findings.fate_evidence: Commit e75cf0a5e checked user.get("type") == "Bot" first and dropped dead app/ prefix check.

notes: Reviewed interactively with 4 subagents; approved after verified fixes.
